votes.quote: The bug: at `src/parseUnifiedDiffToHunks.ts:45`, the check that should skip file header lines can never be true: ... No line starts with both `+++` and `---`, so nothing is ever skipped. This matters when a diff covers more than one file. The next file's `--- a/two.ts` and `+++ b/two.ts` lines get added to the end of the previous hunk as a removed line (`"-- a/two.ts"`) and an added line (`"++ b/two.ts"`)
